member.name: M:FacturaBit.Infrastructure.Persistence.CertificateStorage.RfcPattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[A-ZÑ&]{3,4}\\d{6}[A-Z0-9]{3}$
Options:
RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [&A-Z\u00D1] atomically at least 3 and at most 4 times.
○ Match a Unicode digit exactly 6 times.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-Z] exactly 3 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
